name: philosophy-traceability
purpose: Maps durable operating philosophy principles to executable workspace structures, governance records, and validation handles so philosophy is not left as standalone prose.

reader_guide.summary: Open this file when a philosophy principle changes or when a new rule claims to implement platform philosophy. Every core principle must point to source text, concrete execution targets, and validation handles.
how_to_read: Read required_principle_ids to see the complete set of philosophy principles that must stay mapped.
Read principles to see where each principle is expressed in _philosophy and which docs, workflows, prompts, configs, tools, or projects execute it.
Run check-philosophy-trace after changing _philosophy, governance docs, core workflows, memory anchors, or workspace-health.
Treat validation_targets as handles used by close-out and workspace-health, not as proof that the command was run in this file.
update_triggers: A principle is added, removed, renamed, or substantially reworded in _philosophy.
A policy, workflow, prompt, config, tool, or project becomes the execution home for a philosophy principle.
A principle no longer has a deterministic validation handle.
The philosophy alignment workflow or philosophy traceability checker changes.
workspace-health or memory bootstrap should include a new philosophy-related gate.

structure_rules.rule: Every id in required_principle_ids must appear exactly once in principles and include at least one philosophy source, execution target, and validation target.
structure_rules.reason: A philosophy principle that is not connected to executable structure will be forgotten by future agents.

structure_rules.rule: Each execution target path must exist in the repository and have a clear role.
structure_rules.reason: Traceability should point to real artifacts, not aspirational placeholders.

structure_rules.rule: Each principle must include validation targets that close-out workflows or workspace-health can run or reference.
structure_rules.reason: Philosophy alignment must be checkable before work closes.

structure_rules.rule: This registry must pass check-config-contract before it is treated as a durable shared setting.
structure_rules.reason: The file must explain its purpose, references, structure, and fields in-place.

field_guide.meaning: Complete principle ids that must have traceability mappings.
Principle mappings from _philosophy source text to executable workspace structures and validation handles.
Source philosophy documents and sections that define the principle.
Concrete docs, workflows, prompts, configs, tools, projects, requirements, specs, or dashboards that execute the principle.
Commands or close-out checks that verify the principle remains wired into the workspace.
